artifact_truth.detail: Episode 1 authoritative manuscript places the protagonist outside the study, using the phone in the corridor after leaving the study.
Episode 2 blueprint starts with the phone call in the study-front corridor and preserves the immediate carryover.

code_findings.detail: FlashbackVerifier returns only flat advisory items from check().
Parsed payload keeps marker/issue/referenced_context/severity/check/text only; no local-fix metadata exists.
_advisory_flashback converts FlashbackVerifier output into freeform advisory lines and does not persist structured metadata in _last_advisory_metadata.
Strong advisory escalation requires a ready local fix contract; missing ready fix_pack forces strong_advisory_escalation_non_local_fix.
Existing backfill logic has NpcDrift-specialized synthesis and generic fill-in templates, but no Flashback-specific zero-to-local fix synthesis path.

Flashback advisory is emitted as freeform text only.
Stage4 escalates Flashback as a tier-2 strong advisory.
No structured flashback metadata survives into fix_pack synthesis.
Stage4 downgrades PASS/PASS_WITH_FIX into strong_advisory_escalation_non_local_fix and reroutes to rewrite.
